name: mobile
//overrides: dependency, while Expo SDK 57's react-native-reanimated needs 0.10.x. A caret on a 0.x
version does not span minors, so npm installs a SECOND nested copy. Two copies of a
native module is a build error waiting to happen in any native build, and non-obvious
when it fires. Pinning it to the root version is the standard fix; `$name` resolves to
whatever this package.json declares, so it cannot drift out of step on an upgrade.
//port: Metro runs on 8082, not its default 8081.
8081 is a crowded port — Apache ships on it in several bundles (XAMPP, and the httpd
inside EDB Postgres Enterprise Manager), and Metro loses that fight silently rather
than loudly: it binds [::] in dual-stack mode, so a rival bound to 0.0.0.0:8081 takes
IPv4 while Metro keeps IPv6. A phone or emulator then reaches the wrong server and
reports 'Failed to download remote update', which points at nothing useful.
Moving off 8081 costs nothing and removes the whole class of problem.
web:pkce is deliberately NOT moved — see its own note below.

scripts.//web:pkce: Port 5173 is not cosmetic — it is the callback already registered on the Cognito web client, so AUTH_MODE=cognito-pkce works here with no infrastructure change.
